text:
Jules: Trying to demo the Go quickstart. Client prints a few SSE tokens then stops with a 402 error in the stream. Looks like auth passes but billing gates mid-stream.
mika: which sdk version and sample? paste the exact curl if you can.
onboard-bot: Note: workspace 'acme-pilot' trial expired. Streaming endpoints are restricted until billing is added. See org billing page.
Jules: Using redwood-go v0.3.0 and starter-stream example. Minimal repro: `curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/chat/generate?stream=true\" -d '{"input":"test"}'`
infra-bot: check response headers for `x-rw-trial-state` and `x-rw-reason`. We recently implemented a post-accept gate that can inject a billing control event.
mika: that's awkward UX because clients show partial output. Short-term: demo with `stream=false` or add a quick billing precheck: `GET /v1/orgs/me/billing_status` before SSE.
Sam: Added a blurb to the Go quickstart README advising the precheck and showing a small fallback to a non-streaming generation when `billing_required` is returned.
Jules: Could the Go SDK do the precheck automatically for streaming? It feels super confusing for users to see partial text then an error.
mika: filing DX ticket to add an optional precheck hook in stream manager. @infra-bot can you confirm headers are reliable across edge proxies? :slightly_smiling_face:
infra-bot: yes, but ordering may vary; some gateways emit a 200 handshake then a control chunk. We'll make headers explicit and consider returning an early control when billing blocks.
Jules: thanks. For now updating my demo to not use streaming. Leaving the curl and captured chunks in this thread.
